title: FAIR-bioHeaders semantic mapping table
description: Format of mappings/fhr-jsonld-dcmi.yml (feature 011, research R-02, R-15). One entry per FHR property path gives its JSON-LD term and its DCMI Terms equivalents, each with a mapping kind. Kinds describe the target term relative to the FHR field (SKOS direction). Reused by FHR-Specification#56.

table_version.description: Semantic version of the table. A changed term or kind is a minor bump at least; a removed entry is a major bump.

source_schema.description: The FHR JSON schema the paths refer to (raw-main URL, as in fhr_mappings.yml).

source_schema_version.description: FHR schemaVersion the paths were derived from.

kinds.description: The kind vocabulary with its SKOS equivalent, restated in the file so that readers need no other document. Must equal the enum in $defs/kind.

entries.description: Exactly one entry per FHR property path, in fhr.json property order (nested paths follow their parent).

version.description: Release or date of the target vocabulary, for example schema.org 30.1 or DCMI 2020-01-20.

namespaces.description: Namespace IRIs that terms of this target may use.

path.description: FHR property path: a key, or keys joined by '.', with '[]' after an array-valued key whose items are described, for example assemblySoftware[].commandLineOption[].

term.description: Full IRI of the target term, '@id' when the value is the node identifier, or 'none'.

status.description: Release status of the target term. Required for schema.org terms (core or pending); 'fhr' for FAIR-bioHeaders terms.

condition.description: When the mapping holds. Required for kind conditional.

loss.description: What is lost. Required for kind lossy.

reason.description: Why there is no term. Required when term is none.

subject.description: The resource the statement is about. Default: the assembly. 'record' marks statements about the FHR metadata record (#56 resource model).

coercion.description: JSON-LD value handling, for jsonld mappings only.

type.description: For node-valued mappings, the @type IRI(s) the writer emits (research R-04).

rdf_loss.description: What converting to RDF loses (research R-12), for example order of @set arrays.

jsonld.description: The JSON-LD term. Never 'none' (FR-001): FHR-specific paths use an fhr: term with kind exact.

schemaorg_gap.description: For fhr: terms, why no schema.org term was used (closest candidate and why it was rejected).

dcmi.description: DCMI Terms equivalents, most specific first; a single {term: none} item when there is none.

sources.description: URLs supporting the decision (issue comments, vocabulary pages).
